tone.target: warm clean breakup with chorus and delay sheen
tone.profile: warm clean breakup with chorus and delay sheen
tone.summary: A classic Fender/British combo tone using the US Deluxe or Silver Twin for a clean foundation, enhanced by Chorus and Digital Delay for sheen. The OD 9 provides gentle breakup without heavy distortion.

rig.name: Christophe - Les mots bleus - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide gentle, warm breakup and grit for the clean tone.
blocks.gap: The Blues OD is chosen over Green OD or OD 9 to better emulate a vintage Fender-style tube warmth and subtle compression required for 'cleanish breakup'.
The target tone explicitly avoids hard distortion and high gain.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a warm, clean Fender-style amplifier foundation.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is ideal for the required vintage, clean sound profile (Fender/single coil vibe).

blocks.purpose: Provide a focused, articulate sound suitable for clean tones and single-coil pickups.
blocks.gap: The US 2x12 complements the US Deluxe amp model best for this specific vintage clean tone.

blocks.purpose: Slight tonal shaping to enhance clarity and warmth.
blocks.gap: Used for subtle EQ adjustments rather than major tone shifts, maintaining the clean character.

blocks.purpose: Add the required 'chorus' effect and shimmering sheen.
blocks.gap: None. Chorus is a must-have element.

blocks.purpose: Provide subtle delay repeats for depth and sheen.
blocks.gap: None. Digital Delay is specified and required.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle room ambience to glue the sound together without sounding muddy.
blocks.gap: Room reverb is chosen over Plate/Spring for a natural, non-intrusive background space.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better match the required vintage, articulate single-coil sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance vintage clarity and articulation for clean tones.
